en_title: Street Fighter 6 Reveals Movie Costumes for Zangief, E. Honda and Dhalsim | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
subtitle: 桑吉尔夫兑换码将开放
opus_summary: 卡普空揭晓《街头霸王6》桑吉尔夫、本田和达尔西姆的电影联动服装。桑吉尔夫兑换码将于10月16日起开放领取，全平台通用；另两款服装兑换码将于近期公布。

paragraphs.en: The new Street Fighter movie is just days away, and to celebrate, Capcom is releasing a slew of new Street Fighter 6 costumes tied to the film’s release.
paragraphs.cn: 新版《街头霸王》电影再过几天就将上映。为庆祝电影上映，卡普空将为《街头霸王6》推出多款电影联动新服装。

paragraphs.en: The reveals are part of an online scavenger hunt, where a series of movie-related costumes are being unveiled in various places. Guile and M. Bison costumes have already been revealed, and more costumes will be revealed throughout the month
paragraphs.cn: 这些服装的揭晓是线上寻宝活动的一部分，一系列电影联动服装将在不同地方陆续亮相。古烈和维加的服装已经公布，本月还将揭晓更多服装。

paragraphs.en: First up is Dhalsim, who will be played in the new movie by Vidyut Jammwal.
paragraphs.cn: 首先亮相的是达尔西姆的服装，新版电影中的这一角色由Vidyut Jammwal饰演。

paragraphs.en: Next, we have a look at E. Honda, portrayed in the film by Hirooki Goto.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来展示的是本田的服装，电影中的本田由Hirooki Goto饰演。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we can reveal the costume for Zangief, played in the movie by Borderlands’ Olivier Richters.
paragraphs.cn: 最后，我们可以揭晓桑吉尔夫的服装。电影中的桑吉尔夫由出演过《无主之地》的Olivier Richters饰演。

paragraphs.en: Along with these exclusive images, IGN can reveal the code you can use to redeem your movie-inspired Street Fighter 6 Zangief costume.
paragraphs.cn: 除了这些独家图片，IGN还将公布兑换码，玩家可用它兑换《街头霸王6》中以电影造型为灵感的桑吉尔夫服装。

paragraphs.en: You can claim your Zangief code, which is valid across all platforms, starting on October 16. After you do, be sure to check out the Street Fighter movie, which is opening the same day only in theaters.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家可从10月16日起领取桑吉尔夫服装兑换码，所有平台均可使用。领完后，别忘了去看看《街头霸王》电影，该片也将于同一天上映，仅在影院放映。

paragraphs.en: The Dhalsim and E. Honda costume codes will be revealed soon, so be sure to keep your eyes peeled.
paragraphs.cn: 达尔西姆和本田的服装兑换码也将于近期公布，敬请留意。

paragraphs.en: For more IGN Fan Fest , be sure to check out IGN’s website, YouTube, and social channels throughout the week for more than 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. It all leads to a massive livestream October 14 packed with game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more.
paragraphs.cn: IGN Fan Fest将在本周带来超过90项独家内容，涵盖游戏、电影、电视、漫画和收藏品。活动将以10月14日的大型直播收尾，内容包括游戏公布、预告片、独家片段、名人访谈等。
